cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 shows a national programme teaching the public digital skills. The one project found, for Principe island, covers one region.
cells.note: The regulator AGER found in November 2025 that the digital policy holds no specific action on digital literacy, and listed a national programme only as a recommendation. The Principe project covers one island and the 2016 centre is outside the window, so neither sets stage 2.
